exercises.name: Barbell Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grip the bar across your shoulders and support it on your upper back.
Lower your body by bending your knees and hips.
Drive back up to the starting position.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat on the bench with eyes under the bar.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lower the bar to your chest.
Press it back up explosively.

exercises.name: Deadlift
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge down and grip the bar just outside knees.
Drive through feet to lift the bar close to body.
Lock out by extending hips and knees.

exercises.name: Pull-Ups
instructions: Hang from bar with hands wider than shoulders.
Pull chest up to the bar leading with your chest.
Lower down slowly under control.

exercises.name: Push-Ups
instructions: Start in high plank position.
Lower chest to the floor keeping core tight.
Push back up to starting position.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Lie on an incline bench holding dumbbells at chest height.
Press weights straight up overhead.
Lower with control to sides of chest.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at lat pulldown machine and adjust knee pads.
Grip bar with wide overhand grip.
Pull bar down to upper chest.
Extend arms fully to return.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
Raise arms outward to shoulder height keeping them straight.
Lower back down slowly.

exercises.name: Front Raise
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Raise dumbbells forward to shoulder level.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Lunges
instructions: Take a step forward with one leg.
Lower hips until front thigh is parallel to ground.
Push through front foot to return to starting position.

exercises.name: Calf Raises
instructions: Stand upright on flat ground.
Push up through toes to lift your heels.
Lower down slowly to start position.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells with palms facing forward.
Curl weights upward keeping elbows at sides.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Curl weights upward while keeping neutral grip.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Overhead Dumbbell Tricep Extension
instructions: Hold dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Lower dumbbell behind head by bending elbows.
Extend arms to raise weight back up.

exercises.name: Plank
instructions: Rest on forearms and toes on floor.
Keep body straight from head to heels.
Hold position while bracing core.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit with knees bent and feet slightly off floor.
Twist torso from side to side.
Touch floor on each side with hands.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunches
instructions: Lie flat on your back.
Bring opposite elbow to opposite knee while pedaling legs.
Alternate sides dynamically.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shrugs
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
Shrug shoulders upward as high as possible.
Lower under control.
